description: UK postcodes and company name endings in address searches

boostPatterns.description: A UK postcode, with or without its space (e.g. ZZ9 0TD or ZZ90TD), boosted against the postcode stored without a space. 30 is added to the score of every record with that postcode, worth more than a word or two of the address

prefixPatterns.description: A partial UK postcode: the area, a space, then the start of the second part (e.g. ZZ75 7L), searched as postcodes starting with it
